---
title: "S7 Fig and S8 Fig — Flow cytometry ridge plots (DNA content and cell size)"
author: "Sun et al."
output: html_document
---

**Purpose:** Supplemental Figures 7 and 8.

**S7 Fig:** DNA staining distribution (SYTOX Green B2-A) over 46 h starvation,
ridge plots for WT vs rim15Δ in C, N, P conditions with haploid/diploid controls.

**S8 Fig:** Cell size (FSC-A) distribution over 46 h starvation, same layout.

**Inputs:**
- `analyses/output/dna_b2a_raw.csv` (from `analyses/flow_cytometry_gating.Rmd`)
- `analyses/output/fsc_raw.csv` (from `analyses/flow_cytometry_gating.Rmd`)

**Prerequisite:** `analyses/flow_cytometry_gating.Rmd` must be run first (requires
an interactive RStudio session for the CytoExploreR gating steps).

**Run from repo root:** `rmarkdown::render("sfig/SFig_7_8.Rmd")`

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 2, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 9)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
library(cowplot)
library(scales)

out_dir  <- "sfig/plots"
data_dir <- "sfig/source_data"
dir.create(out_dir,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r constants}
STRAIN_LABELS <- c("WT"      = "WT",
                   "rim15Δ0" = "rim15Δ",
                   "DGY1"    = "WT (haploid ctrl)",
                   "DGY3"    = "Diploid ctrl")

COND_LABELS <- c("C" = "Carbon starvation",
                 "N" = "Nitrogen starvation",
                 "P" = "Phosphorus starvation")

GENO_COLORS <- c("WT"      = "#E69F00",
                 "rim15Δ0" = "#56B4E9",
                 "DGY1"    = "#999999",
                 "DGY3"    = "#cccccc")

out_base <- "./analyses/output"
```

```{r load-data}
dna_path <- file.path(out_base, "dna_b2a_raw.csv")
fsc_path <- file.path(out_base, "fsc_raw.csv")

if (!file.exists(dna_path) || !file.exists(fsc_path)) {
  stop("Flow cytometry data not found.\n",
       "Run analyses/flow_cytometry_gating.Rmd first to generate:\n",
       "  ", dna_path, "\n  ", fsc_path)
}

tidy_ridge <- function(raw_path) {
  read_csv(raw_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      Strain = recode(Strain, "RIM15Δ0" = "rim15Δ0"),
      ridge  = case_when(
        Strain == "DGY3"               ~ "Diploid control",
        Strain == "DGY1"               ~ "Haploid control",
        Time %in% c(0, 6, 16, 30, 46) ~ paste0(Time, " h"),
        TRUE                           ~ NA_character_
      ),
      ridge = factor(ridge,
                     levels = rev(c("Diploid control", "Haploid control",
                                    "0 h", "6 h", "16 h", "30 h", "46 h")))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(ridge),
                  Strain %in% c("WT", "rim15Δ0") |
                    ridge %in% c("Diploid control", "Haploid control"))
}

b2a_raw <- tidy_ridge(dna_path)
fsc_raw <- tidy_ridge(fsc_path)
```

---

# S7 Fig — DNA content ridge plots

```{r dna-ridge-function}
make_dna_ridge <- function(genotype, condition) {
  ctrl <- b2a_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(ridge %in% c("Diploid control", "Haploid control"))
  expt <- b2a_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(Strain == genotype, Media == condition)
  df   <- bind_rows(ctrl, expt)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = value, y = ridge, fill = Strain, color = Strain)) +
    geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 1.5,
                        bandwidth = 500, rel_min_height = 0.005) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1e5),
                       labels = label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = GENO_COLORS, guide = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = GENO_COLORS, guide = "none") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 37500, color = "steelblue",
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    labs(x     = "SYTOX Green fluorescence (B2-A)",
         y     = NULL,
         title = paste0(STRAIN_LABELS[genotype], " — ", COND_LABELS[condition])) +
    theme_cowplot(font_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
}
```

```{r s7-dna-ridges, fig.height=10}
conditions <- c("C", "N", "P")
genotypes  <- c("WT", "rim15Δ0")

dna_plots <- map(genotypes, function(gt) {
  map(conditions, function(cond) make_dna_ridge(gt, cond))
}) %>% unlist(recursive = FALSE)

dna_page <- plot_grid(plotlist = dna_plots, ncol = 3, nrow = 2)
dna_page

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "SFig7_dna_ridges.pdf"),
       dna_page, width = 12, height = 9)

write_csv(b2a_raw %>%
            dplyr::select(Strain, Media, Time, ridge, value),
          file.path(data_dir, "SFig7_source_data.csv"))
message("SFig7: DNA ridge plots saved")
```

# S8 Fig — Cell size (FSC) ridge plots

```{r fsc-ridge-function}
make_fsc_ridge <- function(genotype, condition) {
  ctrl <- fsc_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(ridge %in% c("Diploid control", "Haploid control"))
  expt <- fsc_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(Strain == genotype, Media == condition)
  df   <- bind_rows(ctrl, expt)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = value, y = ridge, fill = Strain, color = Strain)) +
    geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 1.5, rel_min_height = 0.005) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2e6),
                       labels = label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = GENO_COLORS, guide = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = GENO_COLORS, guide = "none") +
    labs(x     = "FSC-A (cell size)",
         y     = NULL,
         title = paste0(STRAIN_LABELS[genotype], " — ", COND_LABELS[condition])) +
    theme_cowplot(font_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"))
}
```

```{r s8-fsc-ridges, fig.height=9}
fsc_plots <- map(genotypes, function(gt) {
  map(conditions, function(cond) make_fsc_ridge(gt, cond))
}) %>% unlist(recursive = FALSE)

fsc_page <- plot_grid(plotlist = fsc_plots, ncol = 3, nrow = 2)
fsc_page

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "SFig8_fsc_ridges.pdf"),
       fsc_page, width = 12, height = 8)

write_csv(fsc_raw %>%
            dplyr::select(Strain, Media, Time, ridge, value),
          file.path(data_dir, "SFig8_source_data.csv"))
message("SFig8: FSC ridge plots saved")
```
